selection.rule: sorted by (word count, doc_id) over eligible documents; lower median

attribution.license: FUNSD License (non-commercial research and education; images under third-party copyright)
attribution.citation: Jaume, Ekenel, Thiran, FUNSD: A Dataset for Form Understanding in Noisy Scanned Documents, ICDAR-OST 2019

ocr: dataset-provided OCR words and boxes (no OCR engine is run)

calibration.guarantee: E[per-document fraction of missed gold fields] <= alpha, for documents exchangeable with the calibration documents

status_definitions.covered: every word's calibrated set is exactly the predicted label
status_definitions.ambiguous_review: every word keeps the predicted label, but some word's set also admits other labels
status_definitions.conflict_review: some word's calibrated set is non-empty but excludes the predicted label
status_definitions.empty_abstain: some word's calibrated set is empty: no label clears its threshold

prediction.redacted: words, boxes and the document image are omitted: the dataset's redistribution terms are not cleared (docs/release/DATASET_LICENSE_AUDIT.md). Re-run tools/showcase_examples.py --full on your own copy of the dataset for the complete output.
